'''Jaroona''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Jaroona and its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] were located on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]], the [[Nothoiin Corridor]], the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], the [[Senex Trace]], and the [[Yankirk Route]]. The planet had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Eriadu (star)|Eriadu]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaroona was first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a [[2004]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA" />
